d: Who was 21-year-old Latif Bhatt, and why did security forces consider his killing a major breakthrough in South Kashmir? Listed as an A+ terrorist with a Rs 15-lakh bounty, Bhatt was accused of targeted killings and recruiting local youth for The Resistance Front (TRF). In this episode, Neeta Sharma examines his rise, his alleged role in local recruitment, the presence of foreign terrorists and what his killing means for security in South Kashmir.
